'''Beralna''' is an [[Aiel]] ''[[Far Dareis Mai]]''. 

== Appearance ==
She is bony with red hair and blue eyes and a feral grin.

== Activities ==
When [[Rand al'Thor]] flees [[Caemlyn]] he sends her to find [[Nandera]] and collect as many [[Maidens of the Spear]] as she wants to go with him to [[Cairhien]].

She greets Rand in [[Bandar Eban]] and points him towards where [[Milisair Chadmar]] is being held.

She brings a large contingent of Maidens to where the power-wrought weapons are being forged at the [[Field of Merrilor]] to have their spear-heads power-wrought.
